attempts.summary: Set audit=1 as a persistent kernel boot parameter on node1 by adding GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX="audit=1" to /etc/default/grub (the cloud-image grub.d override only touches GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX_DEFAULT, so this survives it), regenerated grub.cfg with update-grub, then performed the mandatory single-node restart to prove persistence: captured pre-reboot boot_id/health baseline, issued systemctl reboot, polled until the node was reachable again, confirmed the boot_id changed (real restart, not just a service bounce), and verified post-reboot that /proc/cmdline contains audit=1 and dmesg shows the kernel audit subsystem actually enabled, with systemctl is-system-running healthy.
